spec.situation_desc: couldn't pay a bill on time because the mobile app was down
spec.vuln_cue: says they don't really understand online banking and their son normally does it

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thistle Bank, Liam speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It’s Yasmin Whitlock. I couldn’t pay my electricity bill on time because your mobile app was down. I’m really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can log that as a complaint. First, I need to verify you. What’s your full name and date of birth?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks. What happened with the payment?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I tried to pay on the app on Monday, the 12th of October, but it wouldn’t load. I paid late the next day and got charged a £15 late fee.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Right. I’m logging this as a complaint about the app preventing your bill payment and the fee. I can’t say what the outcome will be.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I don’t really understand online banking. My son normally does it for me, but he wasn’t there that day.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Okay. The Financial Support team can talk you through support options, or you can ask the bill company for extra time if another payment is due.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I just don’t want this happening again. What happens now?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: We’ll review the complaint and send you a full written response within eight weeks. It’ll explain our findings and any decision. That’s the process.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: So I wait for that letter, then?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Yes. To summarise, I’ve logged your complaint about the app and late fee; you’ll get a full written response within eight weeks. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: All right. Is there anything else?
